newsitem.title: USA: NYC mayor calls Time Warner lawsuit "odd".
newsitem.headline: NYC mayor calls Time Warner lawsuit "odd".

text.p: New York City Mayor Rudolph Giuliani said he found it "a little odd" that Time-Warner Inc is suing the city for allegedly viloating Time-Warner's First Amendment rights because city-owned channels will carry News Corp Ltd's Fox News Service.
Time Warner, which operates the city's cable television franchise, is suing to block the city-owned channel from carrying the rival to Cable News Network.

"Those are not serious comments. That's part of the kind of attack mentality that goes on ... I do find it curious that in the name of the first amendment somebody would go to court to restrain someone from speaking," Giuliani said Friday.
"As someone who's argued first amendment cases, that part of it seems a little odd to me," he said.
Fox News is expected to air on the municipal cable channel by midnight, but a hearing this afternoon could affect that.
Bloomberg Television aired on a city cable channel last night.
